why_best: It seamlessly balances high-impact information delivery with a tranquil, premium atmosphere that keeps the user grounded in the experience.
why_bad: Reverting to heavy, opaque pop-ups would aggressively sever the atmospheric continuity and feel harsh against the fluid environment.
trap: Over-blurring the surface panels until they lose their defined refractive edges and crumble into muddy, unreadable grey rectangles.
